VI.description: Copies scan lines of the bitmap hbm into lpvBits in the format lpbmi describes\2C through gdi32.dll GetDIBits (stdcall\2C called in any thread). hbm must NOT be selected into a device context at the time. For 32-bit pixels set lpbmi to biSize 40\2C biWidth w\2C biHeight -h (top-down rows)\2C biPlanes 1\2C biBitCount 32\2C biCompression 0 (BI_RGB)\2C and preallocate lpvBits with w*h elements; each pixel then reads 0xXXRRGGBB. lpbmi is a BITMAPINFOHEADER plus one spare 32-bit colour entry (44 bytes). return value is the number of lines copied\2C 0 on failure. When error in carries an error the DLL is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.

Control.description: A device context (the screen DC will do).
The bitmap (HBITMAP)\2C not selected into any DC.

The pixel buffer\2C PREALLOCATED with width * cLines elements - the DLL writes into it.

When this carries an error the DLL is not called and the error is passed to error out.
